## Claude Code CLI Context Usage Percentage Display Setting

The Claude Code CLI allows you to display a **custom status line** at the bottom of your terminal that can show the **context window usage percentage** (and much more). This is configured via the `statusLine` setting.

### Key Documentation

The official docs page – **[Customize your status line](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/statusline)** – provides full details on how to set this up.

---

### How It Works

The status line runs a shell script that receives JSON session data on `stdin`. The relevant fields for context percentage are:

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `context_window.used_percentage` | Pre-calculated % of context window used |
| `context_window.remaining_percentage` | Pre-calculated % remaining |
| `context_window.total_input_tokens` | Input tokens currently in context |
| `context_window.total_output_tokens` | Output tokens in the last response |
| `context_window.context_window_size` | Max context window size (default 200k, or 1M for extended) |

> **Note:** `used_percentage` is calculated from **input tokens only** (input + cache_creation + cache_read). Output tokens are not included.

---

### Quick Setup Methods

#### 1. Use the `/statusline` command (easiest)

Inside Claude Code, simply type:

```
/statusline show model name and context percentage with a progress bar
```

This automatically generates a script in `~/.claude/` and updates your settings.

#### 2. Manual configuration with an inline command

Add to `~/.claude/settings.json`:

```json
{
  "statusLine": {
    "type": "command",
    "command": "jq -r '\"[\\(.model.display_name)] \\(.context_window.used_percentage // 0)% context\"'"
  }
}
```

#### 3. Manual configuration with a script file

```json
{
  "statusLine": {
    "type": "command",
    "command": "~/.claude/statusline.sh",
    "padding": 2
  }
}
```

Where `statusline.sh` is a script you write that parses the JSON stdin and outputs formatted text with ANSI colors.

---

### Additional Options

| Setting | Description |
|---|---|
| `padding` | Extra horizontal spacing (default 0) |
| `refreshInterval` | Re-run command every N seconds (minimum 1) |
| `hideVimModeIndicator` | Suppress built-in `-- INSERT --` text |

---

### Pre-built Solutions (npm packages)

Several community packages provide ready-to-use status lines:

- **[@daliovic/cc-statusline](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@daliovic/cc-statusline)** – Context %, tokens, rate limits, budget delta, prayer times, MCP servers. Turns orange at 75%.
- **[@allthingsclaude/bar](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@allthingsclaude/bar)** – Three-line display: context (model + tokens + progress bar), session (rate limit), git. Interactive setup wizard.
- **[@zynoo/claude-statusline](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zynoo/claude-statusline)** – Catppuccin Mocha colors, multiple bar styles (diamond, block, dot, arrow, square, shade), compact/single-line mode.
- **[claude-contextline](https://www.npmjs.com/package/claude-contextline)** – Two-line display with battery-style progress bar.
- **[claude-session-status](https://www.npmjs.com/package/claude-session-status)** – Path, model, tokens, color-coded progress bar (green/yellow/red).

---

### Color Coding Example (from community scripts)

Many community scripts automatically color the percentage:

| Usage | Color |
|---|---|
| 0–50% | 🟢 Green |
| 51–75% | 🟡 Yellow |
| 76–100% | 🔴 Red |

Based on the search results, here's a comprehensive answer to making Claude Code's context window utilization **always visible**:

## The Best Approach: Claude Code's Built-in Status Line

Claude Code has a native **status line** feature that can be configured to show context usage (and more) at the bottom of your terminal at all times.

### Quick Setup via `/statusline` command

Simply type in Claude Code's chat:
```
/statusline show model name and context percentage with a progress bar
```

Claude Code will generate a script and configure it automatically.

### Manual Configuration

Add a `statusLine` field to `~/.claude/settings.json`:

```json
{
  "statusLine": {
    "type": "command",
    "command": "jq -r '\"[\(.model.display_name)] \(.context_window.used_percentage // 0)% context\"'"
  }
}
```

### Available Context Window Data Fields

The status line script receives JSON via stdin with these key context fields:

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `context_window.used_percentage` | Pre-calculated % of context used |
| `context_window.remaining_percentage` | % of context remaining |
| `context_window.total_input_tokens` | Input tokens in context |
| `context_window.total_output_tokens` | Output tokens |
| `context_window.context_window_size` | Max window size (default 200K) |

---

## Third-Party Tools (Even Richer Displays)

### 1. **claude-hud** (Plugin) — Most Popular
> A plugin that adds a full instrument panel-style HUD below your input.

```bash
# Install via the cc-foundry plugin system
/claude-hud
```

Shows: context bar (green→yellow→red), tool activity, agent tracking, todo progress, usage limits, git status.

### 2. **claude-code-bar** (npm)
```bash
npm install -g claude-code-bar
claude-code-bar --install
```
Shows: context %, 5h/7d rate limits, git branch, session duration, model name, extra usage spend — all color-coded.

### 3. **Claude Status Line** (IngredLabs) — Floating Overlay
```bash
npx @ingredlabs/claude-status-line@latest
```
Creates an **always-on-top floating window** that shows context %, 5-hour and 7-day rate limits as progress bars. Can be moved, resized, and configured to auto-start.

### 4. **Claude Context Monitor** (VS Code Extension)
Shows context fill % with a traffic-light indicator (green <40%, yellow 40-60%, red ≥60%) directly in VS Code's status bar.

---

## Practical Tips

- **Status line refreshes automatically** after each assistant message, after `/compact`, and when permissions change.
- You can add **padding** and **refresh intervals** in settings.
- **Multiple status line examples** are available in the [Claude Code docs](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/statusline).

For the simplest always-visible context monitor, use **`/statusline`** in Claude Code. For the most feature-rich display, install **claude-hud**.

content.text:
## Claude Code Context Usage 显示方案

### 1. Claude Code 是否有默认显示的 context 使用率 UI？

**默认没有。** Claude Code 默认底部只有一行简单的状态栏（显示 "Claude Code" 或 "等待输入" 等），不显示 context 百分比。

但你可以**通过内置的 `statusLine` 功能自行配置**，让它一直显示在终端底部。这是原生功能，不需要装额外工具。

### 2. 如何让它一直显示？（两种方式）

#### 方式一：最简单 —— 在 Claude Code 里直接输入命令

```
/statusline show model name and context percentage with a progress bar
```

Claude Code 会自动生成脚本并配好 `settings.json`，**立即生效**，以后每次启动都会在底部显示。你可以按自己喜好修改描述，比如只要求 context 百分比不要 model name。

#### 方式二：手动配置

编辑 `~/.claude/settings.json`，加入：

```json
{
  "statusLine": {
    "type": "command",
    "command": "jq -r '\"[\(.model.display_name)] \(.context_window.used_percentage // 0)% context\"'"
  }
}
```

这会在底部显示类似 `[claude-sonnet-4-20250514] 32% context` 的信息，随每次对话刷新。更复杂的样式可以通过写独立 shell 脚本来实现（加 ANSI 颜色、进度条等）。

### 3. statusLine 可用的 context 数据字段

脚本通过 stdin 接收 JSON，相关字段：

| 字段 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `context_window.used_percentage` | 已用 context 百分比（预计算好的） |
| `context_window.remaining_percentage` | 剩余百分比 |
| `context_window.total_input_tokens` | 当前 context 中的 input tokens |
| `context_window.total_output_tokens` | 最后一次 output 的 tokens |
| `context_window.context_window_size` | 最大窗口大小（默认 200K，extended 模式 1M） |

**注意**：`used_percentage` 只计算 input tokens（input + cache_creation + cache_read），不包括 output tokens。

### 4. 进阶：第三方工具（更丰富的仪表盘）

如果你想要更强大的显示（彩色进度条、速率限制、git 状态等），有社区 npm 包可选：

- **[claude-hud](https://www.npmjs.com/package/claude-hud)** — 最流行，插件式仪表盘，显示 context 进度条（绿→黄→红）、工具调用活动、任务进度等
- **[@allthingsclaude/bar](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@allthingsclaude/bar)** — 三行显示：context（模型+token+进度条）、会话（rate limit）、git，带交互式安装向导
- **[@daliovic/cc-statusline](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@daliovic/cc-statusline)** — 显示 context%、tokens、rate limits、预算，75% 变橙色
- **[@zynoo/claude-statusline](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zynoo/claude-statusline)** — Catppuccin 主题配色，多种进度条样式
- **[claude-contextline](https://www.npmjs.com/package/claude-contextline)** — 两行电池式进度条

安装方式一般是 `npm install -g 包名` 然后运行其安装命令。

### 总结

| 问题 | 答案 |
|---|---|
| 默认显示 context 使用率？ | 否，需要配置 |
| 可以一直保持显示？ | 是，statusLine 固定在终端底部 |
| 有相关设置？ | 有，`/statusline` 命令或 `settings.json` 的 `statusLine` 字段 |

**最推荐的做法**：直接输入 `/statusline show context percentage`，一句命令搞定，无需折腾。
